title: Month calendar view with events
when: The user wants a month calendar grid to browse months and add, edit and delete events on days.
prompt:
Goal: A correct month grid for any month and locale, navigable by keyboard, with simple event editing.
Steps:
1. logic.mjs: monthGrid(year, month, weekStart) returns 6 rows of 7 { key, inMonth, isToday } from local Date(year, month, 1); eventsOn(events, key).
2. Render a table with weekday th headers from Intl.DateTimeFormat; each day is a button labeled with the full date and event count.
3. Header: month name, Previous, Today, Next; arrows move focus with roving tabindex, PageUp and PageDown change month.
4. Clicking a day opens a dialog with aria-labelledby and a Close button: list events, add with title, time and color, edit, delete.
5. Up to 3 chips per cell plus "+2 more"; under 600 px show an agenda list for the month.
6. Persist events in localStorage calendar.v1 guarded.
7. test.mjs: February in leap and common years, Monday and Sunday starts, a 6 row month.
Quality bar:
- Today is marked with text for screen readers.
- Weekday names follow the locale.
- Focus returns to the day after closing the dialog.
Pitfalls:
- toISOString keys off by a day.
- Grids that assume months start on Sunday.
- Click only day cells.
Verify:
- [ ] th weekday headers.
- [ ] Dialog has a name and close.
- [ ] Grid tested.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (grid and events), test.mjs.

examples.input: calendario mensal para marcar meus compromissos
examples.output: Monday first grid, Prev/Today/Next, day dialog with events
